candidate_name: Baseline nighttime heart-rate fragmentation as predictor of longitudinal cardiovagal change
scientific_claim: Costa-reference PIP from SHHS visit 1 might predict visit-2 within-person deterioration in respiration-linked cardiac vagal modulation beyond age, sex, mean HR, standard HRV, baseline physiology and clinical covariates.
clinical_target: Longitudinal change in cardiac autonomic physiological PROXY, not confirmed autonomic nerve damage or clinical ANS dysfunction. Requires independent clinical autonomic reference to advance diagnostic claim.
population: SHHS participants with high-quality sinus-rhythm overnight ECG at both PSG visits, acceptable respiratory signal and comparable sleep stage; final eligible sample unknown and NSRR access not yet approved.
novelty_gap: UNVERIFIED: prospective baseline HRF predicts longitudinal within-person change in respiration-coupled cardiac vagal regulation, conditional on full prior-art review and clinical validity.
reference_standard: Two-visit objectively measured respiration-linked ECG cardiac vagal proxy for feasibility; independent clinical autonomic reflex/CASS reference absent.
available_data: Public SHHS documentation confirms 6441 baseline enrolments and 3295 PSGs at visit 2, but study subject-level data are restricted and not accessed.
Costa official AWK reference tested with exact PIP/PNNSS/PNNLS integer matches on all three public test fixtures.
Public Fantasia pilot corrected for 3 quality-eligible annotated records; no longitudinal outcomes.
MrOS public NSRR descriptions indicate 1026 repeat overnight PSGs but same restricted data access and no confirmed independent autonomic clinical reference.
next_falsifiable_test: After NSRR authorization: verify participant overlap, ECG annotation quality, visit-specific sampling frequency and respiratory/sleep-stage waveform feasibility; preregister predictor, a respiration-adjusted physiological change proxy, baseline controls and sample exclusions BEFORE outcome-visit analysis.
rejection_rule: Stop biomarker claim if sampling-grid artifacts explain apparent change, no reproducible physiological proxy survives sensor/respiration/motion confounder sensitivity, or PIP adds no reliable held-out prediction above baseline physiological and clinical controls. A null PIP result must remain publishable.

G1_TARGET.note: Within-person physiological proxy is definable; clinical disease deterioration not defined or independently anchored.

G2_PRIOR_ART.note: Specific longitudinal HRF to breathing-conditioned cardiac vagal proxy prior art not fully screened.

G3_REFERENCE.note: SHHS restricted data unapproved; repeated clinical autonomic reflex/CASS not available.

G4_ANALYTICAL.note: Official Costa three synthetic fixture counts match; not yet validated across sleep sampling frequencies, device changes or clinical populations.

G5_INCREMENTAL.note: Longitudinal risk modeling not fitted; no independent clinical reference.

G6_REPLICATION.note: MrOS repeat PSG feasibility and permission pending.
